{{Short description|Type of tiling in geometry}}
{{Uniform hyperbolic tiles db|Uniform hyperbolic tiling stat table|U54_12}}
In [[geometry]], the '''truncated order-5 square tiling''' is a uniform tiling of the [[Hyperbolic geometry|hyperbolic plane]]. It has [[Schläfli symbol]] of t<sub>0,1</sub>{4,5}.
